Book 19 (子張), second part (units 20–32, passages 19.20–19.25) — keys lacking a glossary entry, with the reading used and where.
(unit numbers are 0-based UNITS indexes for the whole book; passage in brackets)

## Bound compounds (new keys)
仲尼      zhòng ní        Zhongni: Kongzi, by his courtesy name (Zhu Xi on 19.24 puts 孔子 for him: 自絶謂以謗毁自絶於孔子)  — u22, u24, u28 ×3, u29 (19.22–19.25)
公孫朝    gōng sūn cháo   Gongsun Chao: a grandee of Wei (Zhu Xi 朝音潮…公孫朝衞大夫; Ma Rong 朝衞大夫也)  — u22 (19.22)
叔孫武叔  shū sūn wǔ shū  Shusun Wushu: Shusun Zhouchou 州仇, grandee of Lu, of the Shusun house; 武 his posthumous name (Zhu Xi 武叔魯大夫名州仇; Ma Rong 鲁大夫叔孫州仇也武謚也)  — u24, u28 (19.23, 19.24)
陳子禽    chén zǐ qín     Chen Ziqin: Ziqin 子禽 (1.10) with his surname Chen, the Chen Kang 陳亢 of 16.13  — u29 (19.25)

## Single characters (new keys)
紂  zhòu   Zhou: the last king of the Shang (Yin), byword for a wicked ruler (19.20; Kong Anguo 纣爲不善以䘮天下)  — u20 (19.20)
更  gēng   to change, to correct (a fault) (Zhu Xi 更平聲; Kong Anguo 更改也); read gèng 'again, further'  — u21 (19.21)
尼  ní     Ni (in 仲尼)  — u22, u24, u28 ×3, u29
墜  zhuì   to fall, to drop (未墜於地; Kong Anguo 文武之道未墜落扵地)  — u23 (19.22)
常  cháng  constant, regular, fixed (何常師之有; Kong Anguo 無常師也)  — u23 (19.22)
宮  gōng   a dwelling, a house (宮牆; Zhu Xi 言牆髙而宫廣也)  — u25 (19.23)
肩  jiān   the shoulder (及肩)  — u25 (19.23)
窺  kuī    to peep, to look over or through (窺見室家之好; Ruan writes 闚)  — u25 (19.23)
仞  rèn    a measure of seven feet (Zhu Xi 七尺曰仞; Bao Xian 七尺曰仞也)  — u26 (19.23)
宜  yí     fitting, proper; no wonder (不亦宜乎)  — u27 (19.23)
陵  líng   a great mound, a large hill (Zhu Xi 土高曰丘大阜曰陵)  — u28 (19.24)
榮  róng   glory, honour (其生也榮; Zhu Xi 榮謂莫不尊親)  — u32 (19.25)

## Existing keys used in a sense the entry does not cover (please broaden by addition)
食   shí 'to be eclipsed, an eclipse' (of the sun or moon: 如日月之食焉, u21 19.21; He Yan's text writes 蝕)
文   'King Wen, named by his title alone' (文武之道, u23 ×2 19.22; Zhu Xi 文武之道謂文王武王之謨訓功烈…)
武   'King Wu, named by his title alone' (文武之道, u23 ×2 19.22); Wu, a posthumous name (叔孫武叔, u24, u28; Ma Rong 武謚也)
焉   yān 'where?' before the verb (仲尼焉學, u22; 夫子焉不學, u23 19.22; Zhu Xi 焉於䖍反) — the entry has 'how? where?'; add 'from where, from whom'
惡   è 'the bad, evil things' as a noun (天下之惡皆歸焉, u20 19.20); wù beside it (惡居下流; Zhu Xi 惡居之惡去聲)
歸   'to come to rest in, to end up in' (天下之惡皆歸焉, u20 19.20; Zhu Xi 衆流之所歸)
夫子 'that lord': Shusun Wushu (夫子之云, u27 19.23; Zhu Xi 此夫子指武叔; Bao Xian 夫子謂武叔也)
好   hǎo 'fine things, what is good' as a noun (室家之好, u25 19.23)
室   'rooms, the chambers of a house' (室家之好, u25 19.23; Zhu Xi 牆卑室淺)
官   'the offices (of a great house)' (百官之富, u26 19.23) — 百官 'the hundred offices' as at 14.43
云   'saying' as a noun after 之 (夫子之云, u27 19.23)
踰   'to cross over, to climb past' (猶可踰也, 無得而踰焉, u28 19.24)
丘   'a hill: earth piled high' (Zhu Xi 土高曰丘, u28 19.24) — the entry has 'a hill'; add Zhu Xi's gloss
絶   'to cut oneself off (from)' (自絶, u28 19.24; Zhu Xi 自絶謂以謗毁自絶於孔子)
多   duō 'only, merely' (= 祇; 多見其不知量也, u28 19.24; Zhu Xi 多與祇同適也)
量   liàng 'one's measure, one's capacity' (不知量, u28 19.24; Zhu Xi 量去聲…不自知其分量)
為   wéi 'to be counted as' (一言以為知, u30 ×2 19.25); wéi 為恭 'to show respect' (u29; Zhu Xi 為恭謂為恭敬推遜其師也); 無以為 'there is no use doing (this)' (u28; Zhu Xi 無以為猶言無用為此)
階   'to go up by steps, a stair' as a verb (不可階而升, u31 19.25; Zhu Xi 階梯也)
立   'to set (the people) up, to establish their livelihood' (立之斯立, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 立之謂植其生也)
道   dǎo 'to lead, to teach' (道之斯行, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 道去聲…道引也謂教之也; He Yan writes 導)
行   xíng 'to follow' (道之斯行, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 行從也)
綏   suí 'to give ease, to settle (the people)' (綏之斯來, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 綏安也)
來   'to come and attach oneself (to a ruler)' (綏之斯來, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 來歸附也)
動   'to rouse, to drum and dance (the people) on' (動之斯和, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 動謂鼓舞之也) — the entry has 'to move, to rouse'; add Zhu Xi's gloss
和   'concord, to be in concord' (動之斯和, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 和所謂於變時雍)
生   'one's living, while alive' (其生也榮, u32 19.25)
哀   'grief, mourning (for the dead)' (其死也哀, u32 19.25; Zhu Xi 哀則如喪考妣)
